reuse.why: Extends the existing shouldWriteMonthBudgetCategory predicate and reuses extractTagsFromText and getSheetValue, but the new action re-implements the expense sign flip instead of calling the existing averageBudgetAmount helper.

duplication.why: The category+group+notes SELECT is pasted into five functions (setZero, setLastMonthSpending and the three averages) instead of one shared query, and the sign flip duplicates averageBudgetAmount.

placement.why: All rules live in the shared predicate in actions.ts and the new method is registered in app.ts beside its siblings, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Changes are confined to the month-wide actions, their registration and tests; the now-meaningless action parameter is left in place rather than cleaned up.

maintainability.why: One predicate holds all exclusion rules, but five copies of the feeding SQL must stay in sync and the action argument is now dead weight.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions route through shouldWriteMonthBudgetCategory; only the sign flip in setLastMonthSpending sidesteps averageBudgetAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated category query is copied verbatim (with indentation differences) in setZero, setLastMonthSpending, set3/6/12MonthAvg; not disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: shouldWriteMonthBudgetCategory gains an includeHiddenCategories parameter while its action parameter becomes unused; every month-wide action still calls it.
